excluded_responsibilities: Durable Document v2 plan/manifest/prepared storage, Program reconstruction, media authorization, audio/PCM, codec assembly, publication, worker sandboxing, signatures and distributed scheduling are outside this host-bound embedding adapter.
failure_semantics: Nil context, malformed identity, request drift, out-of-range frames, cancellation, panic, render mismatch and arithmetic overflow return no Surface. No fallback profile, partial surface or transient classification is invented.
identity_semantics: The Binding fingerprint covers the complete request scope plus the Program profile, DocumentHash, source-manifest fingerprint, normalized Config fingerprint and a caller-declared implementation fingerprint. It is deterministic integrity metadata, not executable attestation, and it does not prove that legacy plan fingerprints derive from the Document v2 Program.
request_semantics: One Provider accepts only the exact plan fingerprint, execution-manifest fingerprint, timeline, complete RenderTarget and deterministic seed frozen into its Binding, and only composition frame indexes in the bound half-open range.
resource_semantics: VideoResources reserves the Program's complete declared runtime-working ceiling plus fixed adapter overhead, and twice the largest fixed-64-frame canonical surface payload plus CAS publication metadata. Checked arithmetic fails construction before proportional work.
surface_semantics: RenderSurface uses referencevisual.RenderSurfaceFrame and returns its immutable canonical linear-BT.709 premultiplied RGBA16 Surface only after concrete-provider replay, exact receipt comparison and an independently cancelable pixel hash check.
